verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents inviting your accountant to access real-time data and manage the books: journal entries, base currency adjustments, reconciliation and reports. It also documents an audit trail, which supports reviewing their changes. The core review-and-adjust collaboration is covered by first-party marketing copy only. missing for 10: explicit documentation of role-based or scoped permissions for the invited accountant, in-depth help docs on the invite flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
